title: Firebird DEX v1
description: Firebird Data Exchange format, version 1.0. An event is a list of pieces. A piece holds entity data as parallel column arrays (entity id equals array index). References between pieces are declared index columns. Ragged per-entity payloads (trajectory point lists) stay nested.

origin.description: Free-form provenance: source file, producing program, timestamps.

id.description: Event identifier, unique within the file.

piece.description: One named block of typed entity data. `count` entities live in parallel `columns` arrays; a scalar column has `count` values, a fixed-width vector column (like an xyz position) has a whole multiple of `count` values, flattened. A writer declares only the columns it has (a simulation writer omits reconstruction columns); readers bind to declared columns, never to a fixed set.

name.description: Piece identifier, unique within the event. `refs` in other pieces target this name.

type.description: Piece type, selects the reader/painter. Core types use bare names (BoxHit, PointTrajectory); extension types use a namespace prefix (example.CherenkovRing).

version.description: Schema version of this piece type.

origin.description: Free-form provenance, e.g. the original EDM4hep/EDM4eic collection type.

count.description: Number of entities. Every column length is `count` (scalar) or a whole multiple of `count` (flattened fixed-width vector).

refs.description: Declares reference columns: column name -> target piece name (in the same event). Values in a reference column are entity indexes into the target piece; -1 means no reference.

column.description: One parallel array. Homogeneous per column: numbers for measured values and references, strings for labels.

boxHitPiece.description: BoxHit: box-shaped hits. Required columns: pos (flat x,y,z per hit, 3*count values, mm), dim (flat dx,dy,dz box size per hit, 3*count, mm). Optional: time (ns), timeError (ns), edep (GeV), edepError (GeV), each `count` values.

pointTrajectoryPiece.description: PointTrajectory: polyline trajectories. Track parameters are ordinary columns (a writer declares the ones it has: theta, phi, qOverP for reconstruction; pdg, charge, momentum for simulation). The per-trajectory point lists are ragged, so they stay nested in `points`: one list of point tuples per entity, tuple layout declared by `pointColumns`.

pointColumns.description: Meaning of each position in a point tuple, e.g. ["x","y","z","t","dx","dy","dz","dt"].

points.description: Ragged: points[i] is the point-tuple list of entity i; length equals `count`.
